name: Tagalog Republic (1902–1906)
description: A red field charged at the centre with a white many-rayed sun bearing the letter 'K'.
history: Macario Sakay's Republika ng Katagalugan, proclaimed in the mountains of Rizal on 6 May 1902 to continue the fight against American rule, kept the red flag and sun of the Katipunan. Sakay surrendered under a promised amnesty in July 1906 and was hanged the following year.

features.role: sun bearing the Katipunan letter K
